title: Range Carried and Vend-Front Nutrition Labelling by Vending Services Program Programme
content:
What an estate under the Vending Services Program carries is set by the programme the agreement is written at: the number of distinct products carried across the estate, whether chilled fresh food is vended, whether hot beverages are vended, and the depth of the nutrition labelling shown at the vend front.

| Programme | Distinct products carried across the estate | Chilled fresh food vended | Hot beverages vended | Depth of vend-front nutrition labelling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 28 | no | no | basic |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 52 | no | no | basic |
| Combination Vending Bank | 84 | no | yes | standard |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 110 | yes | yes | enhanced |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 180 | yes | yes | enhanced |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 150 | yes | yes | enhanced |

The product count is a whole number of distinct products across the whole estate rather than a count for each machine. The labelling depth takes one of three values — basic, standard or enhanced — and the programme held fixes which of the three the vend front carries.

### The range restated

Chilled fresh food is vended on three of the six programmes: the Fresh Food Vending Service, the Campus Vending Network Service and the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service. Hot beverages are vended on those same three and on the Combination Vending Bank as well, so the Single Machine Snack Service and the Snack & Cold Beverage Bank vend neither chilled fresh food nor hot beverages. The three programmes that vend chilled fresh food are also the three that carry enhanced labelling at the vend front; standard labelling appears once, on the Combination Vending Bank, and basic labelling on the two smallest programmes.

The product count does not follow the rank of the programme throughout: the largest range, 180 distinct products, belongs to the Campus Vending Network Service, and the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service carries 150.
